simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָצִיא (H3329) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.

simple.summary: יָצִיא (yâtsîyʼ) means issue , i.e. offspring First listed occurrence: 2Chr 32 21.

definitions.full: H3329. yatsi [ יָצִיא ] adjective coming forth ; only with מִן and suffix, מֵעָיו ומיציאו 2Chr 32:21 Kt ( וּמִיצִיאֵי Qr), and some of those who came forth from his loins ( בניו in || Isa 37:38 ).
